title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERATV - VehicleTypeConfigParameterSet
description: Vehicle type configuration parameter set (era:VehicleTypeConfigParameterSet's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Stub class linking a VehicleTypeConfiguration (`era:forConfiguration`) with parameters of the VehicleType that depend on that configuration.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VehicleTypeConfigParameterSet'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

assessedCantDeficiency.description: Property. Cant deficiency (maximum uncompensated lateral acceleration) for which the vehicle has been assessed. For dual gauge vehicles values for each gauge have to be indicated.

axleSpacingDistance.description: Property. Position of the axles along the unit. a: Distance between axles; b: Distance from end axle to the end of the nearest coupling plane; c: distance between two inside axles. Embeds era:AxleSpacing (source 'stub' value class, not separately identified).

axleSpacingDistanceA.description: Property. Position of the axles along the unit: a: Distance between axles

axleSpacingDistanceB.description: Property. Position of the axles along the unit: b: Distance from end axle to the end of the nearest coupling plane

axleSpacingDistanceC.description: Property. Position of the axles along the unit: c: distance between two inside axles.

axleSpacingExplanation.description: Property. Explanation of the values for a, b and c

catenaryMaxRatedCurrent.description: Property. Maximum rated current from the catenary (to be indicated for each electrical energy supply system the vehicle is equipped for), given in A.

contactStripMaterial.description: Property. Indication of which contact strip materials are permitted to be used on the infrastructure or with which the vehicles (of the VehicleType) may be equipped with. (RINF/ERATV register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.3.4) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Contact strip materials' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/contact-strip-materials/ContactStripMaterials), 52 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

emergencyBrakeProfile.description: Relationship. Emergency Brake: Stopping distance and deceleration profile for each load condition per design maximum speed. Embeds era:BrakingProfile (source 'stub' value class, not separately identified).

profileDeceleration.description: Property. Maximum train deceleration given in m/s² for a certain braking profile, at design maximum speed.

profileLoadConditionMass.description: Property. Load Condition mass defining the braking profile, at design maximum speed.

profileStoppingDistance.description: Property. Maximum train stopping distance given in m for a certain braking profile, at design maximum speed.

energySupplyMaxPower.description: Property. Maximum power (to be indicated for each energy supply system the vehicle is equipped for), given in kW.

etcsBaselineCompatibility.description: Property. If the ETCS Baseline.Version is not fully compatible, it shall be indicated (use era:etcsBaselineIncompleteCompatibility for textual). Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

forConfiguration.description: Relationship. The configuration for which the ParameterSet or Restriction is valid.

hasAutomaticDroppingDevice.description: Property. Automatic dropping device (ADD) fitted (to be indicated for each energy supply system the vehicle is equipped for).

hasBrakingPerformance.description: Property. Braking performance of a vehicle type (configuration). Embeds era:BrakingPerformance (source 'stub' value class, not separately identified).

serviceBrakingProfile.description: Relationship. Service Brake: Stopping distance and deceleration profile for specific load condition at design maximum speed.

hasCurrentLimitation.description: Property. Electric units equipped with power or current limitation function.

hasOCLChargeableTractionStorage.description: Property. Vehicle equipped with electric energy storage for traction purposes and with the function of charging with OCL at standstill.

hasOnboardEnergyMeasurement.description: Property. TSI conform energy meter for billing purposes installed on board.

hasParkingBrake.description: Property. Indicates if a vehicle type (configuration) has a parking brake.

hasVehicleTypeConfiguration.description: Relationship. It is used to link a vehicle type configuration set with a vehicle type configuration

hasWheelSlideProtectionSystem.description: Property. Indicates the presence of a wheel slide protection system.

massPerWheel.description: Property. Mass per wheel, given in kg.

maxCurrentStandstillPantograph.description: Property. Indication of the maximum allowable train current at standstill expressed in amperes. (RINF/ERATV register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.3, 1.2.2.0.6.1)

maximumBrakeThermalEnergyCapacity.description: Property. Maximum brake thermal energy capacity given in kJ

maximumLocomotivesCoupled.description: Property. Maximum number of trainsets or locomotives coupled together in multiple operation.

minVehicleImpedance.description: Property. Impedance as defined in the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [D] (RINF/ERATV register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.4.2.2, 1.2.1.1.3.2.2)

minimumContactWireHeight.description: Property. Indication of the minimum contact wire height expressed in metres. (RINF/ERATV register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.6)

numberOfPantographsInContactWithOCL.description: Property. Number of pantographs in contact with the overhead contact line (OCL) (to be indicated for each energy supply system the vehicle is equipped for).

quasiStaticGuidingForce.description: Property. Quasi-static guiding force (if exceeds the limit defined in TSI or not defined in the TSI), given in kN.

railInclination.description: Property. An angle defining the inclination of the head of a rail relative to the running surface. (RINF/ERATV register parameter index: 1.1.1.1.4.3) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Rail Inclinations' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/rail-inclinations/RailInclinations), 22 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

shortestDistanceBetweenPantographsInCont.description: Property. Shortest distance between two pantographs in contact with the OCL (to be indicated for each energy supply system the vehicle is equipped for; to be indicated for single and, if applicable, multiple operation) (only if number of raised pantographs is more than 1).

totalVehicleMass.description: Property. Total vehicle mass (for each vehicle of the unit), given in kg.

vehiclePantographHead.description: Property. Pantograph head geometry (to be indicated for each energy supply system the vehicle is equipped for). Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'CompliantPantograph Heads' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/compliant-pantograph-heads/CompliantPantographHeads), 6 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

vehicleTypeMaximumSpeedAndCantDeficiency.description: Property. Relates the vehicle type with its values of maximum speed and cant deficiency. Embeds era:MaximumSpeedAndCantDeficiency (source 'stub' value class, not separately identified).

vehicleTypeMaximumCantDeficiency.description: Property. Part of the combination of maximum speed and maximum cant deficiency for which the vehicle was assessed. Corresponds to the maximum cant deficiency.

vehicleTypeMaximumSpeed.description: Property. Part of the combination of maximum speed and maximum cant deficiency for which the vehicle was assessed. Corresponds to the maximum speed.
